window_definition: All timestamps are from the D host's monotonic clock except single-host P durations. Rate windows are fixed arithmetically before replay. Empty D while P pending counts time with a P HTTP in flight for that D and no unfinished, handed-off request. D engine queue samples are separate from that event-derived interval. KV-ready bytes are payloads counted when the last D rank finishes. Client output rates use exact streamed token counts, including partially completed requests.
